texts.aboutSettings: Bridge Smart Panel devices to Apple Home via local HomeKit Accessory Protocol (HAP). Use the wizard to select which devices should be bridged.
texts.outOfSyncDescription: The displayed configuration could not be synchronized with the backend. Changes cannot be saved until the configuration is reloaded.

name.title: Bridge Display Name
name.description: The name displayed for the bridge in Apple Home

port.title: TCP Port
port.description: Local port for the HAP server (default: 51826)

pinCode.title: Pairing PIN Code
pinCode.description: 8-digit PIN in XXX-XX-XXX format used to pair with Apple Home

validation.format: PIN code must be in XXX-XX-XXX format

wizard.title: Apple HomeKit Gateway Setup
wizard.devicesDescription: Choose which Smart Panel devices should be bridged into Apple Home. Only compatible devices with mapped services will appear in Apple Home.
wizard.searchPlaceholder: Search devices by name or room...
wizard.bridgeLimitWarning: Apple Home recommends a maximum of 150 accessories per bridge. Adding more may lead to instability or pairing issues.
wizard.scanWithCamera: Scan with the Apple Home or Camera app on iPhone/iPad
wizard.instruction1: Open the Apple Home app on your iOS or macOS device.
wizard.instruction3: Scan the QR code or enter the 8-digit PIN code manually.

config.notEdited: Failed to update HomeKit Gateway settings.

messages.pinCopied: Pairing PIN code copied to clipboard.
messages.confirmResetPairing: Are you sure you want to reset Apple Home pairing? Existing Apple Home connections will be disconnected and you will need to re-pair the bridge.
messages.pairingResetSuccess: Pairing credentials reset. You can now pair with Apple Home.
messages.saveBeforeAction: Please save or discard your settings changes before continuing.
messages.refreshFailed: Failed to synchronize configuration with backend.
messages.outOfSyncBlock: Configuration is out of sync. Please reload before saving.
